name: PröllerAlm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to PröllerAlm in Gerlos – your alpine paradise in the heart of Tirol!**

Nestled at **1,600 meters** above sea level, **PröllerAlm** offers breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps** and the **Gerlostal Valley**, where untouched nature meets pure relaxation. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, this alpine retreat has something for everyone.

**Hiking & Nature**
Explore the **Gerlostal** on countless well-marked trails, from gentle walks through lush meadows to challenging ascents to the **Hochfeiler** or **Ahornspitze**. The **PröllerAlm** is also the perfect starting point for family-friendly hikes, such as the scenic route to the **Gerlos Waterfalls** or a leisurely stroll along the **Gerlosbach River**.

**Culinary Delights**
Indulge in authentic **Tiroler** cuisine at our cozy mountain hut. Savor freshly prepared dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** with apple compote, hearty **Käsespätzle**, or a perfectly grilled **Tiroler Gröstl**. Pair your meal with a cold **Gerloser** beer or a glass of local **Apfelstrudel** wine—because every bite should be as unforgettable as the view!

**Accommodation & Comfort**
Our rustic yet modern **Almhütten** provide a warm retreat after a day outdoors. Enjoy the crackling fireplace, soft **Tiroler** hospitality, and the soothing silence of the mountains. Whether you're here for a weekend escape or a longer stay, **PröllerAlm** promises an authentic alpine experience.

**Events & Traditions**
Experience the spirit of **Tirol** with traditional **Almabtriebe**, live music evenings, or guided tours through the **Gerlostal**. In winter, the area transforms into a snowy wonderland for cross-country skiing, sledding, and winter hikes.

**Get Here & Away**
**PröllerAlm** is easily accessible by car (about **30 minutes** from **Innsbruck**) or via public transport (bus from **Gerlos** village). Parking is available right at the **Alm**.

**Plan Your Visit**
Open from **May to October**, **PröllerAlm** invites you to disconnect, recharge, and reconnect with nature. Whether you're a seasoned hiker, a food lover, or simply in search of peace, this hidden gem in the **Zillertal** will leave you spellbound.

**We look forward to welcoming you at PröllerAlm in Gerlos!** 🏔️✨
